$description: Rhythm/position/dependency rules. Rules here and RULES in schema/semantic_validate.py are two sources for one fact; verify_all.py fails if their ids or severities diverge.

toneModel.sequence: shell A (home, about, pricing): hero (nav, hero, photo stack) then surface (demos, safety table, plans, footer); never back to hero. Shells B/C/E: light throughout. Shell D: app throughout.

feature.demo-card.note: consecutive demo cards are the measured rhythm (one grid, gap 96); the variant order draft -> questions -> comments is fixed

docs.section.note: consecutive sections are the measured rhythm (gap 32)

motionBudget.note: at most one card runs at a time in practice: each clock runs only while >= 12% of its card is visible. Sub-routes: one typewriter (about, pricing), one photo stack (about); changelog, docs, legal and auth have no page motion.

rules.description: PageSpec.route must be one of the declared template's routes (and the template must exist).
Every node's (section, variant) must be a node of the DECLARED template, cross-referenced against templates.json, not checked in isolation.

A (section, variant) may repeat only when its template node is repeatable:true, and then at most maxRepeat times (docs.section 6, legal.section 21). feature.demo-card appears up to three times on home, once per variant.
Nodes follow the template's order exactly; optional nodes may be skipped, never moved; repeatable nodes stay contiguous.
Every template node marked required:true is present (home: nav, hero, draft demo, footer; every sub-route template: all of its nodes).
An optional node (questions or comments demo) is omitted: valid, but the only measured composition contains it.
Nodes with position first/last are nodes[0] / the last node: shell.nav, shell.app-header and auth.form-mock first; shell.footer and legal.footer last.
Each node's anchorId equals its template node's anchorId (draft / questions / comments / safety; null otherwise). '{slug}' (docs.section, legal.section) means a per-instance slug is required.
Node tone equals the template node tone: hero (gradient band), surface (page tint), light (white landing shells B/C and auth), app (legal app shell).
Every '#id' href resolves to a node anchorId on the same page or a template pageAnchor (legal: #top).
Every '/route' href is a built route or a documented pending-build route in templates/routes.json.
An href targets a pending-build route; the target project must supply that page (one warning per route). v1.1.0 has no pending-build routes, so it cannot fire until one is added.
node.motion equals the section contract's motion for that variant (the schema const-locks the same values).
node.motion.reducedMotionFallback is present and equals the contract's pinned value.
Every text and prose field respects its contract maxWords (runs are counted joined).
Every text and prose field respects its contract maxChars.
Typed/streamed text finishes inside its fixed timeline window: len <= floor((endMs - startMs)/msPerChar).
A media slot's assetRole is one of the roles that slot allows.
A media object's generationPolicy equals its role's policy in assets/asset-roles.json (catches a swap to another valid policy).
assetRef must not name a source-site file (basename match against asset-roles sourceFiles).
No string (or sentence of >= 5 words) matches a fingerprint of terms.so's proprietary long-form text (home + the six live sub-pages).
brand.name is not the source brand, and no string references a source domain (terms.so, the operator's studio/founder sites, its source repository).
shell.nav[on-hero-current].currentHref equals the PageSpec route and one of the nav links' hrefs.
shell.footer[brand-two-groups] (home) lists /changelog among its 5 Product links; shell.footer[brand-two-groups-subpage] lists 4 and no /changelog.
A prose field carries at most its contract maxLinks linked runs.
Per-instance anchorIds ('{slug}' nodes) are present and unique on the page, and never collide with another node's anchorId.
changelog.releases are newest first (strictly descending datetime) and each datetime is a valid date.

Legal pages carry every required project-supplied operator slot ({{operator.legalName}}, {{operator.postalAddress}}, {{operator.country}}, {{operator.governingJurisdiction}}); body text may reference only those tokens.
legal.intro.counselReview is 'required-before-publication': generated legal text must be replaced/reviewed by the operator's counsel; placeholder copy is not legal advice.
The legal switcher links to both legal routes of the template and the PageSpec route is one of them.
auth.form-mock.demoOnlyNote is present and says the form is a demo and not functional.
auth.form-mock wires no real credential handling: behaviour consts intact, every href is an internal route, no endpoint URL anywhere in the node.
auth.form-mock.switchLink points at the other auth route (/sign-in <-> /sign-up).
